findings.evidenceJa: 半身の麻痺は完治した
findings.governingReading: Saber asks whether paralysis of half his body has fully healed.
findings.explanation: Half-body paralysis again becomes unspecified numbness.

findings.highlight: I have no place if my Master is still wounded.
findings.governingReading: 立つ瀬がない describes Saber’s inability to justify her standing with her charge still wounded.
findings.explanation: An untenable position again becomes having no place.

findings.governingReading: 取り繕って says he puts on a calm appearance after the unfamiliar red outfit has derailed his thought.
